result.title: EXPOSURE: Explaining Sources of Uncertainty in Reinforcement Learning
result.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ESANN 2027. Code: https://github.com/kianaf/exposure-rl
result.summary: Shapley values in reinforcement learning are used to explain which observation features drive an agent's behavior and expected return, but not its certainty. Explaining certainty requires understanding how observation features influence different sources of return uncertainty, and Shapley values need the agent's prediction for every subset of visible features. We propose EXPOSURE, which uses one mask-aware belief network for both action selection and Shapley explanations. It explains the variance of the return, split into an observational part due to missing features and an inherent part due to the environment's own randomness, and the entropy of its belief over the masked features. In tic-tac-toe and Minesweeper, where exact Shapley values are computable, EXPOSURE gives more accurate explanations of expected return and its uncertainty, while uniquely explaining belief uncertainty.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EXPOSURE，用单一的 mask-aware belief network 同时执行动作选择与 Shapley 解释，将回报方差分解为缺失特征导致的可观测部分和环境固有部分，并解释模型对遮挡特征的信念熵；在井字棋和扫雷中与精确 Shapley 值对照验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对缺失特征、信念熵与不确定性来源的分解，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、继续 LOOK 的决策及 latent 状态不确定性归因提供概念线索；但研究限于小型 RL 任务，与 VLM 推理的距离需进一步核查。
